part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in the grammar (`src/parser.y`): `ElseBody` only accepted `elif...` or `else ... end` branches, so an `if/elif` chain without `else` had no way to reach `end`.

Changes:
- Added a bare `"end" { $$ = gen_noop(); }` alternative to `ElseBody` (src/parser.y:622-629), making the `else` clause optional even after `elif`s.
- Removed the now-redundant `"if" Exp "then" Exp "end"` rule, which otherwise caused 36 reduce/reduce conflicts with the new rule.
- Regenerated `src/parser.c`/`src/parser.h` with bison and rebuilt.

Verified:
- `1,2,3 | if . == 1 then 1 elif . == 2 then 2 end` now yields `1 2 3`, matching the `else .` variant.
- Multi-level `elif` chains and plain `if/then/end` still work; keyword object keys (`{"if":1,...}`) unaffected.
- Full test suite passes (`make check`: 7/7 PASS).
